info.title: NestJS Auth Starter
info.description:
Authentication and authorization on the official `@nestjs/authentication` and `@nestjs/authorization` packages.

- **Browsers** sign in with `POST /auth/login` and get an HttpOnly `__Host-sid` session cookie.
- **Mobile apps and CLIs** use `POST /auth/token` for a Bearer access token and a rotating refresh token.
- **Scripts** use personal API keys (`Authorization: Bearer nak_…`).

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `errorCode`.

password.description: No policy here: changing the policy later must not lock anyone out.

mfaRequired.description: True when the session still needs a TOTP or recovery code (`POST /auth/mfa/verify`).

recoveryCode.description: A one-time recovery code, instead of `code`.

token.description: The token from the emailed link (`?token=…`).
The token from the emailed link (`?token=…`).

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Opaque and single use: exchange it at `POST /auth/token/refresh`.

uri.description: `otpauth://` URI to render as a QR code.

recoveryCodes.description: Shown once. Each works one time.

redirectTo.description: Relative path to land on after signing in.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the key stops working. Omit for a key that never expires.

key.description: The whole key. Shown once; only a hash is stored.
